birthdayLetter.title: For Amena
birthdayLetter.body:
Happy birthday, Amena.

This is not a normal birthday page, because you are not getting a normal birthday system. Somewhere between the Arc Reactor, the Quantum Map and JARVIS deciding that this entire operation required far too much engineering, this became a little world built around you.

Tony Stark gets the workshop. Thor gets the thunder. Natasha gets the precision. Wanda gets the impossible. Clint gets the focus. And somehow, all five ended up on the same board for one very important mission: celebrating you.

I hope November 27 gives you a year full of moments worth keeping. I hope you get surprised, laugh until it hurts, find people who make ordinary days better, and have the kind of memories that refuse to fade.

If JARVIS reports a Level 7 emotional event, please understand that I had no intention of arguing with him.

Happy birthday, Amena.

The system is yours now.

— THE STARK PROTOCOL

explore.commonRoomText: A private command deck built around a glowing core, moving telemetry, holographic-style diagnostics and a seat reserved for Amena.
explore.candleText: The old candle system has been retired. The reactor chamber now powers the interactive Stark Lab experiences.
explore.mapText: Coordinates shift, anomalies appear and AI-generated missions can be created on demand.
